app.title: Karate Tournament
about.subtitle: Karate tournament manager
about.tagline: A portable, offline-first app to run a karate tournament across multiple arenas: import fighters, auto-group them into fair age/weight/gender categories, generate single-elimination brackets, run bouts with per-fight timers, and show winners on a live projector podium — no internet or Docker required.
about.tip: Import your roster, press Auto-group to build categories, assign an arena and generate brackets, then open a bracket to run fights. Editors control one arena; the projector view is public.
about.manualHint: See MANUAL.md in the project folder for full step-by-step instructions.
about.licenseHint: All rights reserved. See the LICENSE file.
about.credits: Built by Cympire · Fastify + React + Prisma/SQLite
about.f.grouping: AI auto-grouping into WKF-style age, weight and gender divisions
about.f.brackets: Single-elimination brackets (up to 8) with a bronze match
about.f.live: Live updates across every screen over WebSocket
about.f.timers: Per-bout and break timers with alarm, one fight at a time
about.f.podium: Winners' podium announced on all projector screens
about.f.i18n: English, Russian and Hebrew with full RTL support
about.f.import: Roster import from Excel/CSV and full data export
